Metadata.title: AWS Student Builder Group — Antalya Belek University
Metadata.description: A student community at Antalya Belek University that learns and builds with cloud technologies together. Events, workshops and learning resources.

Hero.title: AWS Student Builder Group
Hero.description: We are a student community that learns, experiments and builds with cloud technologies together. Whatever your major or level, you are welcome to join us.

Join.title: Join the community
Join.lead: Join one of our channels so you never miss an event or announcement.

learn.title: Learn by doing
learn.body: Learn cloud technologies step by step in hands-on workshops.

build.title: Build together
build.body: Turn your project ideas into reality with your teammates.

network.title: Meet new people
network.body: Meet students from different departments who are into cloud and software.

certify.title: Prepare for certification together
certify.body: Work through a certification roadmap that starts with Cloud Practitioner.
